zh-CN.title: 证据驱动的技能进化
zh-CN.description: 在回归用例与宿主校验通过后才提议技能修改，对比新旧结果，并可回滚到已确认的版本。

usage.title: 安装并授权
usage.description: 通过 make extension-install 安装示例，在 config.yaml 中配置 skill mutation 与 evidence 授权后重启 Gateway。

usage.title: 记录回归用例
usage.description: 在包的 cases 目录添加 JSON 用例，用 file_exists、text_contains、text_not_contains 等静态检查描述这次修改要修复什么。

usage.title: 提出、评估、应用与回滚
usage.description: 调用 /api/extension-skill-evolution/proposals 提交候选版本，查看 justified、unjustified 或 failed 结论；通过后 apply，必要时 revert 到已确认版本。

requirements: 需要支持 skill_mutations 的持久化数据库、run_events.backend: db，以及单实例 POSIX 本地磁盘。
需要在 config.yaml 中显式授予 skill mutation 与 evidence 访问权限。

en-US.title: Evidence-gated skill evolution
en-US.description: Propose skill edits only after a regression case and host checks pass, compare old and new results, and roll back to a known-good revision.

usage.title: Install and grant access
usage.description: Install the example with make extension-install, configure the skill mutation and evidence grants in config.yaml, then restart Gateway.

usage.title: Record a regression case
usage.description: Add a JSON case under the package's cases directory using static checks such as file_exists, text_contains and text_not_contains to state what the change fixes.

usage.title: Propose, evaluate, apply and roll back
usage.description: Submit a candidate to /api/extension-skill-evolution/proposals, inspect the justified, unjustified or failed verdict, apply an accepted revision, and revert when needed.

requirements: Requires a durable database backend, run_events.backend: db, and a single POSIX host with local disk.
Requires explicit skill mutation and evidence grants in config.yaml.
